item.text: {"brief":"The user wants a study plan for law school exams in two months, focused on civil law. They mentioned a regular study schedule and a general overview, though the intended scope of the overview is unclear. They specified three hours per day, prefer one long study session, and explicitly exclude weekends. The three-hour response did not distinguish current study time from future availability. Specific civil-law topics, syllabus, jurisdiction, and exact exam dates remain unspecified."}
